jobs.title: Elite Armed Security: Executive & Residential Protection
jobs.description:
A security solutions provider is seeking an Armed Flex Executive Protection/Residential Security Agent in Austin, Texas. The ideal candidate will ensure the safety of clients and their properties, respond to emergencies, and maintain vigilance while managing security protocols. Candidates must possess a Texas Security Guard Card, excellent observational skills, and the ability to operate under dynamic conditions.

Flexible hours are required, and applicants must be eligible for a background check and willing to work nights and weekends.

jobs.title: Armed Driver Patrol Officer — Austin | $30/hr
jobs.description:
Allied Universal in Austin, TX is seeking an armed Security Officer to join our driver patrol team. This full-time role pays $30.00 per hour and offers a structured morning schedule, 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, at a technology-focused site.

You will provide customer service to employees, visitors, and contractors, respond to incidents and alarms, and conduct regular patrols across buildings and perimeter areas while ensuring post orders and laws are followed.
